test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two numbers a and b are such that a: 24 :: 24 : b, and a : b :: b : 192. Find the value of (a + b).
solution:
**Given:**

Two numbers a and b are such that a: 24 :: 24 : b, and a : b :: b : 192.

**Calculation:**

⇒ a : 24 :: 24 : b

⇒ ab = 24²

⇒ ab = 576 .....................(i)

Again,

⇒ a : b :: b : 192

⇒ b² = 192a

⇒ a = b²/192 ........................(ii)

Put the value of a in (i) from (ii),

⇒ (b2/192)b = 576

⇒ b³ = 576 × 192

⇒ b = 48

Put the value of b in (i)

⇒ ab = 576

⇒ 48a = 576

⇒ a = 576/48

⇒ a = 12

⇒ a + b = 48 + 12 = 60

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
